decisions.reason: The evening psychiatric day program launched only last year and has its own page, so its value is still uncertain and it fits the firm's core care competencies, which makes keeping the option open worthwhile.
The custom furniture workshop is probably tied to sheltered employment, so it runs cheaply on existing staff and workers, and after one year it is too early to judge its market value.
Outpatient sociotherapy is only mentioned on the website, which signals a low commitment, but it costs little to maintain and its demand is not yet revealed, so the option stays open.
Senior living counseling appears on the home page, which shows strong commitment, and it costs little while feeding demand into the firm's core residential care business.
The retail shop is only mentioned and carries some ongoing cost, but it sells existing sheltered-workshop output, and one year is not enough evidence to justify dropping it.
